verdict: Alphabet's revenue rose 22% to $109.9B as Google Cloud growth accelerated to 63% — and a $37.7B paper gain on its equity stakes lifted net income 81% to $62.6B.

segments.name: Google Services
segments.note: Search, YouTube, subscriptions and devices. Search revenue grew 19% as AI answers drove record query volumes, and YouTube ads grew 11%.

segments.name: Google Cloud
segments.note: Cloud computing for businesses — growth accelerated to 63% on enterprise AI demand, and the order backlog nearly doubled in one quarter to over $460B.

segments.name: Other Bets
segments.note: Moonshot projects like Waymo self-driving cars (now over 500,000 paid rides a week); they lost $2.1B at the operating level.

segments.name: Hedging losses
segments.note: Losses on Alphabet's currency-hedging program, which exists to smooth out exchange-rate swings on its overseas revenue.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Engineers and AI research; up 26% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling ads and cloud contracts, and marketing Google's products.

otherDetail: A net gain of $37,716M, primarily net unrealized gains on non-marketable equity securities — stakes Alphabet holds in private companies, revalued upward.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Cloud is booming
takeaways.text: Google Cloud revenue jumped 63% to $20.0B and its operating profit more than tripled to $6.6B. The cloud order backlog nearly doubled in a single quarter to over $460B.

takeaways.title: A paper gain bigger than most companies earn
takeaways.text: Other income was a $37.7B net gain, mostly unrealized gains on stakes Alphabet owns in private companies. That is why net income rose 81% while the operating business grew its profit 30%.

takeaways.title: Subscriptions keep compounding
takeaways.text: Paid subscriptions across Google reached 350 million, led by YouTube and Google One, and the Gemini app had its strongest quarter yet — a growing cushion of recurring revenue next to ads.

oneTimers: Other income includes a net gain of $37.7B, primarily unrealized gains on non-marketable equity securities (stakes in private companies). It is a paper gain — the main reason GAAP net income of $62,578M is so far above the $39,696M the operations earned before tax.
